name: Predict outcomes of complex physical scenarios
description: Users asked the AI to analyze specific, often complex or hypothetical physical scenarios to predict outcomes, explain mechanisms, or calculate feasibility. These requests focused on qualitative predictions or conceptual explanations of novel setups—such as unusual object interactions, extreme conditions, or thought experiments—rather than solving standard textbook homework problems.
